tech.summary: Google ke Project Suncatcher ke prototype satellite ne apne onboard TPU par Gemma 4 model chala kar khala se pehla AI jawab bheja — ek haiku: 'Blue marble below / Data streams in silent grace / Starlight feeds my core.' Satellite 1 October ko SpaceX Falcon 9 par launch hua tha, aur sirf 1 kilowatt power par ek waqt mein sirf ek chip 20 minute chala sakta hai. 2027 mein laser links wale do aur satellites ki planning hai.
tech.title: Google ka AI ab khala se shayari bhej raha hai — satellite par pehla poem

tech.summary: Reuters ke mutabiq OpenAI ke employees ChatGPT se pehle se hi internal security par sawal utha rahe the — code ek hi monorepo mein, sensitive info aasani se accessible. October mein executive conference room mein recording device milne ke baad company ne ek chauthai production engineers security par laga diye hain, aur ab 'next internal security sprint' ki planning hai.
tech.title: OpenAI ke apne log saalon se security ki warning de rahe the — Reuters report

tech.summary: New York Times ne Brave par Manhattan federal court mein case kiya hai — ilzaam hai ke Brave ne 30 billion pages ka index bana kar khabrein copy kein, AI companies (Anthropic, Perplexity, Mistral, xAI, Cohere) ko bechi, aur paywall bypass feature bhi diya. Daily News, Chicago Tribune aur Orlando Sentinel ne bhi alag case file kiya hai.
tech.title: New York Times ne Brave browser par case kar diya — AI scraping ka ilzaam

tech.summary: Meituan ne LongCat-2.5 launch kiya hai — 1.6 trillion parameters wala multimodal model jo lambi agentic coding tasks ke liye bana hai, aur poori tarah domestic Chinese accelerators par train hua hai. Company ke apne benchmarks ke mutabiq ye Claude Opus 4.8 aur 5 ke darmiyan hai, lekin independent testing abhi baqi hai — is liye numbers ko claim hi samjho, faisla nahi.
tech.title: China ka Meituan le aaya LongCat 2.5 — 1.6 trillion parameters, sirf Chinese chips par trained

tech.summary: OpenAI ne former US Secretary of the Army Dan Driscoll ko senior counselor for national security modernization banaya hai — wo leadership ko advise karenge ke advanced AI national security aur cybersecurity mein kaise use ho. Driscoll is saal ke shuru mein Pentagon se resign kar chuke hain, aur Ukraine-Russia talks mein bhi Trump ke liye kaam kar chuke hain.
tech.title: OpenAI ne ex-Army Secretary Dan Driscoll ko national security role de diya

tech.summary: China ke National Development and Reform Commission ne kaha hai ke 15th Five-Year Plan (2026-30) mein 'AI Plus' initiative ko gehra kiya jayega — AI ab sirf pilot projects se nikal kar research, production aur distribution mein coordinated tareeqe se use hogi, taake nayi economic growth paida ho.
tech.title: China ka 'AI Plus' ab full speed — 2026-30 plan mein har industry mein AI

pakistan.summary: Haftay mein doosri dafa petrol sasta: hukumat ne petrol Rs 5.45 kami ke baad Rs 369.06 aur diesel Rs 3.68 kami ke baad Rs 391.52 per litre kar diya hai, 4 November se effective. OGRA ke mutabiq global crude taqreeban 2% gir kar 3 haftay ki low par aaya, is liye ye kami mumkin hui.
pakistan.title: Petrol phir sasta — Rs 369.06, diesel Rs 391.52, aaj se nayi qeematein

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne apne pehle indigenously developed air-to-air missile Fa'az ka kamyab flight test kar liya hai — ISPR ke mutabiq is mein state-of-the-art terminal guidance system hai aur ye lambi range par aerial targets ko engage kar sakta hai. Test JF-17 fighter se hua, aur sadr, wazir-e-azam aur army chief ne scientists ko mubarakbad di.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ka pehla apna air-to-air missile Fa'az — JF-17 se kamyab test

pakistan.summary: Mohmand district mein polio team ki security duty par jaate hue 2 policemen shaheed aur 1 zakhmi ho gaya; Tank mein 4 polio workers ko aghwa kar liya gaya. KP Governor ne fori recovery ka hukm diya hai. Ye waqiat us waqt hue jab 24 million bachon ki vaccination campaign jaari hai — Pakistan aur Afghanistan hi ab polio-endemic mulk reh gaye hain.
pakistan.title: Polio duty par hamla — Mohmand mein 2 policemen shaheed, Tank mein 4 workers aghwa

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne Lahore mein Sri Lanka ke khilaf tri-series final jeeta — 326 ka target 3 wickets aur 9 balls pehle chase kiya, Fakhar Zaman ke 127 (99 balls) ki badolat. Lekin slow over-rate par team par 5% match fee jurmana bhi laga; captain Shaheen Shah Afridi ne ghalti maan li.
pakistan.title: Tri-series jeetne ke baad bhi jurmana — Pakistan par slow over-rate fine, Fakhar ka 127 yaadgar

pakistan.summary: ISPR ke mutabiq 1 November ko Kachhi aur Kharan mein intelligence-based operations mein 17 dehshatgard halak hue — Kachhi ke Sanni area mein 10 (roadblock ki koshish nakaam), Kharan mein 7. Firing ke dauran 25 saala Sepoy Hikmatullah shaheed hue; Sadr Zardari ne un ki qurbani ko khiraj-e-tehseen paish kiya.
pakistan.title: Balochistan mein 2 operations — 17 dehshatgard halak, Sepoy Hikmatullah shaheed

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Stock Exchange mein Tuesday ko bullish session raha — KSE-100 Index 1,454.80 points (0.87%) barh kar 168,018.86 par band hua. Topline Securities ke mutabiq US-Iran talks ki umeed par crude sasta hua, jis se investor sentiment behtar hua; rupee bhi halka mazboot ho kar Rs 276.71 par aa gaya.
pakistan.title: PSX mein tezi — KSE-100 1,455 points barh kar 168,018 par band
